The exact current raw supplier hash remains b1d3cdef7ef0e5c009281076ea499045f6a7e7da39bbbfd8750b47c1ccb17335, matching the observed carrier. Owner must route correction, synchronize supplier metadata and review actual direct/indirect physical consumers before closure. The local batch-12 scaling algebra is sound independently of the material map; both owned risk reviews remain open. No completed repair or closed ledger row is claimed.
